page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Faint marks in the right margin, not legible as text. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: pe ex tabulis, quæ meæ sunt, confecta. D. imò mea. Q. V-trius sit? R. Quia lex eius esse speciem quanque uult, qui eā effecit. F. At non alter potest esse tabularum, alter nauis dō minus. Cum autem tabulæ meæ sint, nec sine meo facto alterius fieri possint, lex superior ex posteriore intelligenda est: quasi adiecta sit exceptio, nisi ex aliena materia species facta sit. D. An ea demum species effectoris sui fit, qui suam ex suâ materia effecit. quòd si ex aliena materia facta sit, eius sit qui materiæ est dominus. Respondetur: semper speciem effectoris es[?]

page.notes: The right margin shows only faint specks and marks, with no legible printed notes. The last line ends at the right margin, and "se;" at the foot is a catchword, read with some doubt. The printed "es" at the end of the last line is read as "es" with the long s rendered as s, so the final letters are uncertain. The line "m 5" is the gathering signature.
